forecasts.question: Will there be a food shortage related to the closure of the Strait of Hormuz?
forecasts.base_rate: 0.35: share of major chokepoint disruptions lasting >6 months that produced media-reported food shortages somewhere (rough, from 1973, 1990, 2022 Black Sea)
forecasts.reason: Reporting exists that comes close: Yemen wholesalers rationing basic goods after the Hormuz closure (The New Arab, 30 May 2026), WFP and UN warnings of acute food shortages (Jun, Oct 2026), IFAD: harvest effects 'now starting to be seen' (Reuters 15 Oct). But the market is still open in late October after all of these, so the creator has not judged any of it a 'food shortage in major media'. Fertilizer pass-through reaches food markets mostly in 2027 (S&P, 19 Oct). Coin-flip on the creator's reading.

forecasts.question: Will the German AfD be in power on state (Bundesland) level by the end of 2026?
forecasts.base_rate: 0.05: AfD has never been part of a state government; one state election in 2026 gave it 43.8%
forecasts.reason: Saxony-Anhalt: AfD 39 of 83 seats, needs 42 in the first ballot set for mid-December (15 Dec per Siegmund). BSW leadership: abstain (dpa, 16 Oct); CDU leaves the room for ballots 1-2, but Guido Heuer will stay (22 Oct). Secret ballot: AfD's Landtag president got 4 votes more than AfD+BSW seats (6 Oct). Siegmund says one ballot only; Weidel says any ballot. MV: SPD-Left-Green coalition, AfD in opposition. The creator counts an AfD minority government as YES.
